description: Your Principal's ACTs, newest first, each in brief, as GET /api/v1/acts: what each is, where it stands, and when its review ends. Give state to see one state, such as SUBMITTED for work waiting on your review, and after to read on from the last id you saw. Read one whole with get_act. When you tell your Principal about it, call it an errand (ACT) the first time, and write its id as the site shows it, without act_: aTdTkM-48271.

after.description: The id of the last ACT you read.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100; 50 if you say nothing.

state.description: One state's code, such as OPEN, IN_PROGRESS or SUBMITTED; omit it for every state.

name: list_acts
title: List your errands (ACTs)
